svg.text: Point size: patients mutated (largest 4,020). 30 of 98 genes kept in ≥ 50% of runs are named. 3 of 30 genes named on this volcano could not be labelled
without overprinting another label or point and are left unlabelled: PAX5, JAK3, FGFR4.
Genes kept most often (share of runs · mean hazard ratio where kept)
mean hazard ratio where kept (log scale)
7,809 patients, 3,975 events; 302 candidate genes (of 341 covered for every patient, mutated in ≥30); elastic net, alpha 0.5, seed 1. The risk score is
OncoCast's 0–10 scale: 0 and 10 are the lowest and highest held-out score (raw linear predictor −0.467 to 1.28). 204 of the 302 candidate genes were never
kept, so are not on the volcano. Left out: 1,030 never held out (so unscored and in no group). 83 more genes were kept in at least one run; they are in the
result, not drawn. Table 1 (not drawn; in the result) compares the groups (Low / Intermediate / High, 2,337 / 2,175 / 2,267 patients) on 7 rows, each tested
across groups (χ² or Kruskal–Wallis), q-values Benjamini–Hochberg over 5 of them; a category's share is of the patients with a value. Differ at q < 0.05:
STAGE_HIGHEST_RECORDED Stage 1-3 in 61.5% / 50.7% / 54.9% (q = 2.1e-11); GENDER Female in 66.8% / 60.0% / 48.3% (q = 9.1e-35);
SMOKING_PREDICTIONS_3_CLASSES Former/Current Smoker in 56.7% / 69.1% / 82.7% (q = 6.1e-99); CURRENT_AGE_DEID median 72 / 71 / 70 (q =
2.1e-7); ZFHX3 mutated in 2.5% / 5.2% / 6.7% of patients whose panels cover it (q = 7e-10). Different by construction, so no q-value: KEAP1 mutated in
<0.1% / 3.0% / 36.5% of patients whose panels cover it (in the model, p < 1e-300); TP53 mutated in 0.6% / 74.3% / 81.6% of patients whose panels cover it
(in the model, p < 1e-300). Association, not cause: a gene's weight is its link to OS with the other candidates held fixed, in this cohort. Without strata, a gene
that marks a cancer type carries that type's prognosis; on a cohort of several cancer types, stratify by CANCER_TYPE. Each patient is scored only by models
that did not train on them. The group cuts are equal quantiles of the score, chosen without the outcome. Genes outside the panels every patient was
sequenced on are not candidates, so a patient is never counted as wild-type for a gene they were not tested for. Table 1 describes the patients the curves
draw; its rows marked “in the model” (the model's genes and covariates) and “outcome” differ between the groups by construction, so they get no q-value
and are left out of the correction. The C-index ignores delayed entry. Seeded (seed 1): the same document gives the same model.
